definitions.direct_save: A diner adds a dish to their shortlist. This does not prove a purchase.
definitions.unsave: A diner removes a previously saved dish from their shortlist.
definitions.undo_restoration: Undo restores a previously unsaved dish. It is not a new direct Save.
definitions.duplicate_delivery: Identical deliveries of the same event are deduplicated by event ID and counted once.
definitions.story_end_saved_state: The dishes remaining Saved at the end of an observed story. This is not verified completed-session retention.
definitions.observed_save_retention: Among observed visits that directly saved a particular dish, the proportion that still have it Saved at the end of the observed visit. This is descriptive, not verified order completion or causal conversion.
